title: Understand SHC Members and Captain Election
objectives: Understand SHC Members and Captain Election
Verify actual state through a separate inspection or query.

tasks.instruction: In APL, open Settings → SHC operations (V7). Inspect the three-member majority, captain and separate KV Store primary.

Stop sh01 using the labeled member service control or native CLI, advance an operation tick and inspect the elected sh02 captain. Start sh01 and advance again. Verify all three members are available, sh02 remains captain and the KV primary can be sh01. Do not remove a member from the profile.

hints: Inspect running versus disk source and use the correct component.
Keep the fixture clock paused and advance deliberately to observe transitions.
